summary: Controlled re-entry across three modalities — all Z1-Z2, shoulder-safe strength, habit formation before load is raised

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Aerobic base establishment, Z1-Z2, conversational pace

steps.description: Z1 easy walk/jog, <145 bpm — let HR climb naturally, hip openers as you move
Z2 aerobic 146-162 bpm — conversational, full sentences, back off if HR exceeds 162
Z1 easy walk/shuffle, <145 bpm — shake out legs, 60s hip flexor stretch each side

sessions.name: Aerobic Spin — Leg Flush
sessions.focus: Low-load aerobic cycling, non-impact leg flush after Monday run

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 85-90 rpm, <145 bpm — no pressure, joint lubrication, pedal stroke feel
Z2 aerobic 146-162 bpm — 85-90 rpm, steady effort; reduce watts if HR exceeds 162 bpm
Z1 easy spin down, <145 bpm — near-zero resistance, slow cadence fine

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Week 1 Foundations
sessions.focus: Neuromuscular activation, lower body and core only, shoulder-safe
sessions.notes: 2 rounds of circuit — 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. Exercises: Goblet Squat 10x 16kg (hold at chest, if shoulder pain switch to sumo squat held between legs); Romanian Deadlift 10x 2x11kg; TRX Split Squat 8 reps/leg bodyweight; Band Clamshell 15 reps/side light band; Dead Bug 8 reps/side bodyweight; Plank 30 seconds. NO shoulder loading. Note any shoulder aggravation for coach review.

steps.description: Bodyweight squats x10, glute bridges x10, leg swings front/back x10/side, hip circles x10/side — slow and deliberate activation
Circuit: Goblet Squat 10x 16kg | RDL 10x 2x11kg | TRX Split Squat 8x/leg | Band Clamshell 15x/side | Dead Bug 8x/side | Plank 30s — 60s rest between exercises
90s rest between rounds — shake out legs, controlled breathing
Pigeon pose or figure-4 stretch 60s/side, standing hip flexor stretch 45s/side, hamstring floor stretch 45s/side

summary: Extend aerobic volume slightly — runs and rides get 5 min longer, strength adds a third round; still Z1-Z2 dominant, shoulder re-assessment

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run — Extended
sessions.focus: Z2 aerobic base, 35 min — slightly longer than Week 1

sessions.name: Aerobic Spin — Extended
sessions.focus: Z2 steady state, 35 min, build aerobic engine

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — 3 Rounds
sessions.focus: Progress to 3 rounds, introduce single-leg glute bridge, reassess shoulder for cautious pulling

summary: Introduce first structured intensity — one Z3 tempo run or Z3 cycling block; strength load increases with heavier dumbbell options; still 80/20 distribution

sessions.name: Z2 Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Z2 base maintenance, 30 min — legs fresh for Thursday tempo

sessions.name: Tempo Introduction — 2x8 min Z3
sessions.focus: First structured intensity — 2x8 min at Z3 142-168W with Z1 recovery; build lactate tolerance

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Load Progression
sessions.focus: Increase goblet squat to 22kg, add step-ups and Nordic hamstring curl with band, 3 rounds

summary: Recovery week — cut volume ~40%, intensity drops to Z1-Z2 only; let Week 1-3 adaptation land before the next 4-week block

sessions.name: Short Easy Run — Recovery
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 only, 20 min, flush legs and maintain movement pattern

sessions.name: Mobility & Light Activation
sessions.focus: 1 round of Week 3 circuit at reduced load, extended stretching — 25 min total
